Name: The Friendly Snowman - NPC Jack
Author: ParcySnippet
Description:
[center][size=6]☃️🌼 ﻿[b][color=#fff2cc]Features[/color][color=#9fc5e8] 🌼[/color][/b]☃️[/size][/center]
[color=#d8d8d8]
[b][size=4]Note:[/size][/b] [size=3][u]This mod is safe to add midsave, in every season, and you don’t need to start a new save to have the best experience[/u], but the mod can only be activated during winter 1-7, so that you don’t miss too much dialogue during the rest of the season. You CAN still add the mod if you are in later winter, he just won’t show up until next year![/size][/color]
[color=#cccccc][size=3](And you can use the [u][b]Forum[/b] tab if you'd like to leave a comment[/u].)[/size][/color]

[b][size=4]﻿[color=#fff2cc]Please also keep in mind:[/color][/size][/b][color=#fff2cc] [size=3]That ﻿while the story does get sad near the end, it is not all doom and gloom! [u]Small spoiler[/u] for what happens when he melts away: [/size][/color]
[spoiler]
He reflects on his life and comes to the conclusion that it was meaningful even if it was short. He also gives the player his hat if you reach 4 hearts with him.[/spoiler]

[color=#fff2cc][size=3]And like I mention farther down below, [u]he will return in an update[/u] (with an explanation in the story).[/size][/color]

[quote][color=#fff2cc][b][size=4]This mod adds:[/size][/b][/color]

[color=#fff2cc][size=3]A new, [/size][/color][color=#fff2cc][size=3]giftable npc that you build during the winter season[/size][/color][color=#fff2cc][size=3]

An entire in game month's worth [/size](and more)[size=3] of unique dialogue[/size]

[size=3]Two new events[/size]

[size=3]A new special item, if you manage to become good friends with a snowman before he melts away[/size]

[size=3]And more to come as I continue to update and improve this mod![/size][/color][/quote]
[b][size=5]🍊[/size][color=#fff2cc][size=4]Other [u]Important[/u] info:[/size][/color]
[/b]
[quote][color=#fff2cc][size=3]Jack currently only stays around for one winter after you build him in the first event, and melts away shortly after spring comes around.

However, he [b][i]will return[/i][/b] the following year and onwards the future 2.0.0 update I am working on. Before that. there will also be a smaller update that adds letters.

It’s [b][i]worth noting[/i][/b] though that you may not see all the letters before his return event depending on when you download both separate updates, and where you are in the game. I will post a small [b]guide[/b] on this mod page listing all the letters you should receive however, so check back here when the letter update happens if you are concerned about missing any![/size][/color]

[color=#fff2cc][size=3](Also, this mod was made for[b] [i]modfest[/i][/b] and I put this together in a little less than a month, so there's a lot of things left that I want to add and improve on! Please keep an eye out during the following months for more updates to come! I will also try my best to keep the mod up to date in the future, for whenever 1.7 comes out.)[/size][/color][/quote]
[size=5]🍰 [/size][b][color=#fff2cc][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/color][/b]

[quote][size=3][color=#fff2cc]Should not conflict with SVE, Ridgeside, or most other mods, as Jack doesn't exactly do much! His spot at the Bus Stop and the immediate area surrounding it must be free though. If you run into any issues, you can let me know in the Technical Help section of the Forum tab on this mod.

As of now, these are the ﻿known incompatibilities:

> [b]Hardware Store[/b]—it’s an older mod located at the bus Stop, and while [u]neither mod breaks the other[/u] when used together, you will see a sad snowman’s portrait year round when accessing the store.

There’s nothing I can do to fix this on my end, as the issue is likely being caused by the other mod’s dependency "Shop Tile Framework" which is pulling my npc’s portrait from the same area for some reason. [u]Shop Tile Framework probably shouldn’t use Jack’s portrait if it is the dependency of a mod outside of the bus stop though[/u]. Let me know if it happens, and I’ll update the list.[/color][/size][/quote][b][color=#cccccc][size=3]A little fun fact: while this is my second published mod and first released npc, it is actually [i]not[/i] the first npc I’ve ever made![/size][/color][/b]

[b][size=5]🍊[/size][size=4][color=#fff2cc]Credits and special thanks:[/color][color=#f9cb9c] [/color][/size]

[/b][color=#cccccc][size=3]I would like to thank all the kind people helped me out with the coding for this mod:

Abagaianye, Atra, Button, Chu, Fireredlily, Lunette, Nic, Pneuma163, Selph, and Si.

And I would like to thank Dolphin for both coding assistance and writing advice. I appreciate you being willing to give your thoughts on my story to help me make it the best I could![/size][/color]
